facts.text: Audrey regularly grooms her dogs to keep them looking good and healthy.

evidence.quote: Regular grooming is essential to keep them looking good. Daily brushing, regular baths, nail trims, and lots of love is what helps them stay healthy and happy.

facts.text: Audrey finds taking care of her dogs to be a rewarding and meaningful responsibility.

evidence.quote: Taking care of them is a big deal. It makes me really happy and I take that responsibility seriously. It can be tough but it's super rewarding.

facts.text: Audrey has a strong bond with her dogs and wants to make them as happy as possible.

evidence.quote: I love them so much and I want to make them as happy as possible. We have a strong bond.
